title: Algebraic circuit evaluation
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $C$ be an algebraic circuit in $n$ variables with input assignment $x\in R^n$. Its value is the value of the last gate in the list produced by running the circuit; if the circuit has no gates, its value is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: algebraic circuit C on n variables
